notes.title: UPDATE N°1 Post release
notes.notes:
Hello people,

I have work a lot the last days to improve the gameplay of AFFRAID.

It seems that some player find the game too difficult to understand.

I have decided to add or fix a few features:

2 Hints UI has been added to ease the comprehension of the most important part of the game mechanics.

The level Numbers (that appear in each level) will stay longer at screen so you can understand where you are. 
And keep in mind that a map is available for the following levels in the inventory (LVL3, LVL5, LVL10, LVL09, LVL15) Press tabulation to show it.

I have added a Vsync option in the main menu options

I have added the controls directly on the screen. It will appear when you leave the first room.

Objectives are more visible, stay longer at screen and come with a new little icon. 

I will soon give the solution for the whole game so stay tune until the next update.

Why no stream? Because my connection is really bad!!

THE DEV

notes.title: UPDATE: Version 1.1 is now available
notes.notes:
Hello people,

As usual, I am working hard to bring you the best version of Affraid. 
I have improved the general sense of the gameplay, something the game developer call "the juice"!
The game will be juicier to play from now. There are some points to improve but they will come in time

Before that here is the list of upgrades:

New UI images

New VFX for bullet tracer and muzzle fire added to each shot

Camera shake stronger at each shot

New VFX for the gaz canister

Assault rifle range increased

Pistol range increased 

Aim system upgrade with laser pointer for more precise fire

Challenge objective point improved with the distance from the player character.

[previewyoutube=eRyAZNubcyM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to wishlist AFFRAID!

Bye

Eddy

notes.title: AFFRAID Version 1.0 is live
notes.notes:
Hello people,

I really appreciate all the support I receive for the conception and development of this game, so thanks to all the followers!

I have work everyday to bring you a better AFFRAID the last days. The game have already change from its demo appearence. A lot of bug has been removed and above all a lot of feature has been added.

Here is the list of updates:

NINA (the main character) can now turn her head around in the same manner as Haydee in the game Haydee. In Resident Evil 3, Jill could not turn her head around I found that this feature add life to the character.

New First aid kit Management system: Now, you can stock the fist aid kit for future use when your life is full. A new UI will appear with your health and the number of First aid kit stocked. It is not found in the inventory because the inventory has not been designed to stock and remove asset from time to time. (I wrote the code myself and I did not use an already made inventory system)

UI animations have been added everywhere! The interface is more alive!

And the biggest updates is the possibility to choose the language among:
French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Korean, Russian, German and Japanese.

It is not yet complete but You can eventually play AFFRAID in your mother tongue!

NEXT?
A leaderboard so you can track your results and see your level in this game.
A new character or a new foe maybe some sort of umbrella corp soldiers?!

Leave a comment and don't forget to wishlist this game if it is not yet done!

Eddy

notes.title: Version 0.9 is live
notes.notes:
Hello dear players and future players,

I am happy to announce a new version of AFFRAID.
As you already know, AFFRAID is an Action horror game inspired by Resident evil and Haydee!

I find also a lot of inspiration on the game The killing antidote.

What is the difference between the demo and the final version of the game?

AFFRAID can offer you at least 1 hour of game for the first run and more if you play the different difficulty level or the challenge mode.

I did add a challenge mode where you need to fight you way up the end of a labyrinthe.

The history itself include about 16 levels with increasing difficulty.
I will not tell it enough...READ THE INSTRUCTIONS at the beginning of each level and don't forget to open the inventory by pressing tabulation button to look at the map.

I added 5 maps correponding to the levels 03, 05, 09,10 and 15. They will allow you to find your way and not get completely lost. I know the way but you don't so I want to ease the game a bit by this way.

Compared to the version 0.7, the game have now 2 different type of zombies. The original version, the grey one has been removed. The newer versions are a bit similar to the zombie of RE3.

What next?
I would like to translate the game into 5 languages at least....A lot of work ahead!

The DEV
